two of them are practice; the third is the crystals
Cryo-cooling and single-particle reconstruction are choices that hardened into defaults, and a field
could in principle choose differently — whatever they systematically hide is hidden across most of the
record at once, and depositing more of the same does not find it. The space group did not move across
twenty years of everything else changing, which is what a property of the objects looks like rather than
a property of the field. Reading all three as one “the PDB is a monoculture” claim merges a fixable
habit with a fact about proteins.
RCSB PDB search API, fetched 2026-09-22; one terms facet per field per deposition year. Each share is over the entries that record that field in that
year, not over all depositions, and the three denominators differ — they are drawn at the right for exactly that reason. Change is quoted as a
three-year mean at each end, 2005–2007 against 2023–2025, and 2013–2015 against 2023–2025 for cryo-EM because before that it records under 160 entries
a year. An earlier version of this figure read 87% at 100 K from a *histogram* bucket, which is everything in [100, 125) K; the exact value is used
